name: Inquisitor's Trap silences the first enemy to approach it and all enemies within 5 yd (#783)
contract: Inquisitor's Trap 681445 (installed Spell.dbc) is a 60000 ms cooldown SUMMON of creature 506251 in front of the caster (TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT), duration index 3 = 60 s; its silence helper 681447 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE (27) with duration index 32 = 6000 ms and radius index 8 = 5 yd. Tooltip: 'Place a cruel trap on the ground lasting 1 min that will curse the first enemy to approach it silencing them and all enemies in a 5 yd radius for 6 sec.' The behaviour is not in Spell.dbc alone: spell_script_names binds 681445 to spell_ascension_witch_hunter_summon and creature_template 506251 to npc_ascension_witch_hunter_field (AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp), whose AI polls every 250 ms for a valid enemy within 3 yd, casts 681447 on every valid enemy within 5 yd of it and despawns. The fixture layout does not depend on the player's facing: enemy a stands 2 yd from the caster, enemy b 3 yd (1 yd from a, so inside the silence radius whichever of them triggers the trap) and enemy c 20 yd away. All are level-60 hostile dummies and the hunter has spell hit rating 10000. GEOMETRY CORRECTED after slot 3 runs: the field AI finds enemies with Acore::AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck, whose WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap adds both units' object size (combat reach; Object.cpp _IsWithinDist), so the ranges are edge to edge: creature_model_info gives the trap model 1.0 and Harvest Golem 36 1.275, hence the 3 yd trigger reaches an enemy up to 5.275 yd from the trap and the silence radius around the triggering enemy reaches 5 + 2 x 1.275 = 7.55 yd. Measured with owned_creature_count min_distance: the trap stands 2 to 3 yd from the caster. Enemies at 6 or 9 yd were therefore inside the ranges (and an enemy standing exactly on the caster was never picked as the trigger in five runs), so the fixture now uses an enemy at 2 yd (always inside the trigger range whatever the trap's direction) and a far enemy at 20 yd (beyond 3 + 5.275 + 7.55).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture: the far enemy is 20 yards away
Drop Inquisitor's Trap in front of the hunter
The first enemy in reach is silenced
An enemy within 5 yd of it is silenced too
An enemy 20 yd away is not
The silence lasts at most 6 seconds
